subject: Acme POC  Integration plan, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-retail.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Dan Miller <dan.miller@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acme POC  Integration plan, success criteria, and next steps

Hi Jordan / Priya 

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned for the 3-week POC:

High-level success criteria (what Acme has to see to consider a win):
- End-to-end integration with product search and support chat flows using Redwood API (latency under 400ms median for 256-token requests).
- Match/beat current retrieval+rank baseline for purchase intent queries (measured on the evaluation set you shared).
- Consistent throughput for expected peak of ~25 rps during business hours without errors.
- Ability to stream partial responses for live chat UI and support function/tool calling for automated inventory lookups.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + provide integration artifacts (SDK snippets, API spec, POC checklist). Owner: Marissa (Redwood) + Jordan (Acme).
- Week 1: Integration & smoke tests (auth, SDK init, basic generate endpoint). Owner: Acme eng + Redwood SE.
- Week 2: Load/latency testing + quality eval on your sample prompts. Owner: Acme + Redwood SRE/SE.
- Week 3: Review results, adjust config (quantization/batching), go/no-go decision.

POC ownership & contacts:
- Redwood: Marissa Cole  AE (me)  overall owner; Connor O'Brien  Solutions Eng (technical lead); Rishi Malhotra  SRE/Deployment support.
- Acme: Jordan Lee  Product; Priya Shah  Eng lead; Dan Miller  Security/Infra.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm the success criteria above or add any items we missed.
2) Share a short list (10 20) of representative prompts/queries for the quality eval (you mentioned a filtered set during the call).
3) Confirm the primary contact for provisioning (API keys, IP allowlist) and a preferred kickoff time next week.

I've attached a one-page POC plan and the initial integration checklist for your team. Connor will follow up with concrete SDK and streaming examples.

Looking forward 

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: ACME-POC-plan-v1.pdf, acme-integration-checklist.xlsx

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-retail.com>, Dan Miller <dan.miller@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC  Integration plan, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks Marissa  this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- Streaming: We will need partial response streaming to support our live chat widget. Can you confirm whether you support both SSE and WebSocket streaming, or a preferred approach?
- Tool calling: We plan to use a function-calling style for inventory lookups. Does your API support structured tool calls (name + json args) and automatic routing back to our APIs?
- Security/compliance: Dan needs the SOC2 evidence + data retention details before we can provision keys. Can you share the relevant docs?

I can send the 10 20 eval prompts by EOD. For kickoff, would Tuesday 03/17 at 10:00am PT work for our eng + product?

Cheers,
Jordan
Jordan Lee  Product Manager, Acme Retail
jordan.lee@acme-retail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-retail.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC  Integration plan, success criteria, and next steps

Jordan  perfect. Tuesday 03/17 10:00am PT works for us.

Looping in Connor (SE) and Rishi (SRE) to cover the technical details you asked about and to own the integration support during the POC. Connor  please see Jordan's streaming and tool-calling questions below and add any SDK/snippet attachments you want to share.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30 45m):
- Introductions & goals (5m)
- Provisioning & network/security checklist (10m)
- Integration walkthrough (SDK init, auth, generate + streaming) (15m)
- Next steps & timeline confirmation (5 10m)

I've attached the POC plan and checklist to this thread. Connor  if you can provide the SDK snippets and an example function-calling flow before kickoff, we'll get those into the kickoff deck.

Thanks,
Marissa
